messages:
Aisha (Finance): FYI we've had repeated payment failures for customer Stellar Apps — invoice INV-2024-332 for $18,450. Gateway shows 3 declines in the last 24h.

Billing Bot: charge failed for customer c_cust_7h... error=card_declined code=do_not_honor gateway_tx=gtx_9ab

Marco (Support): Customer reached out. Says card limit hit, prefers to pay via wire. Asked for wire instructions — wants immediate access.

Aisha (Finance): Can we provide wire details and hold retries? I don't want us to retry if they switch to wire. @Priya (Payments) can you approve a manual retry policy or should we cancel retries and wait for wire?

Priya (Payments): Approve holding retries. Do NOT attempt card retry if customer confirms wire. If they opt for ACH, we can guide them through micro-deposits and then try. Approve one manual retry only if customer explicitly asks us to retry the card.

Devon (Sales Ops): Customer is on a negotiated annual plan; losing access is a risk. They said they'll wire immediately if we provide instructions. Prefer to accept wire and reinstate access on proof of payment.

Aisha (Finance): Ok — I'll send wire template and mark invoice pending-wire. Wire instructions (send to customer):

Bank: Redwood Financial, NA
Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account number: 987654321
Routing (ABA): 111000025
SWIFT: REDWUS33 (for international wires)
Reference: INV-2024-332 / Stellar Apps
Beneficiary address: 450 Market St, Suite 200, Redwood City, CA

Note: For ACH (US) we support micro-deposit verification or Plaid link. Steps for ACH: 1) Customer clicks https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup 2) We send two micro-deposits < $1.00 3) Customer confirms amounts -> we enable ACH and settle.

Marco (Support): Sending the wire template now. Customer asked explicitly to pause any automated retries. I told them we'll hold off until we see confirmation of wire or ACH setup.

Aisha (Finance): I'll cancel the scheduled retry for this invoice. If we do need to attempt a manual retry later, here's the internal command we use:

```bash
curl -X POST \"https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/customers/c_cust_7h/payments/retry\" 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_API_KEY\" 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2024-332","attempt":"manual"}'
```

Billing Bot: scheduled retry canceled for invoice INV-2024-332 by user Aisha (Finance)

Priya (Payments): Noted. If wire isn't received by EOD +3 business days, open a collections ticket and start dunning cadence. If they set up ACH, mark invoice as pending-ACH and do not retry until micro-deposits verified.

Aisha (Finance): Pay-Infra — could you attach the gateway logs (last4, decline_code, gateway_tx) to the ticket for our audit trail? We need decline codes for compliance.

Pay-Infra (Infra Team): Attached gateway log snippet to ticket: gateway_tx=gtx_9ab errors=[card_declined(do_not_honor), decline_code=insufficient_funds], card_last4=4242, exp=02/26. Let me know if you need full payload.

Devon (Sales Ops): I'll keep the customer on a temporary access hold until payment clears; we agreed to reinstate immediately on proof of wire.

Aisha (Finance): Thanks everyone. Summary: hold retries, send wire instructions, await confirmation of wire or ACH setup, attach logs, collections if no payment by EOD+3. I'll update the ticket after the support thread updates.
